item.tib: sangs rgyas don yod zhags pa'i sgrub pa las yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang mchog byin rlabs kun 'byung g.yu zhags ljang mo
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas lcags pho khyi yis (yi) lor/ khro chu'i brag gi gsang phug nas gter las drangs pa'o/ slar rab brtan phag gi lor rgyal rong dbang gi rgyal po bstan 'dzin pho brang bsam 'grub seng ge'i rdzong nas shog ser las zhal bshus grub pa'o//
